name: worktree
description: The Worktree plugin — makes parallel Claude Code sessions in one repository actually usable, by bootstrapping each new worktree and isolating its runtime from the others.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: Bootstraps a new git worktree into a runnable checkout and isolates its runtime: copies gitignored config, installs or hardlinks dependencies inside the repo's own toolchain shell, and gives each worktree its own port, env overrides and seeded state. /worktree-calibrate fits all of it to your repo once; the hooks are deterministic bash from then on.
